status: Authored development panel; no model outcomes are specified.
purpose: Measure reader decisions under fixed reports, reader packets, and factual-edit controls before scaling.
authoring_notes: Derived from the four authored cases in Four-case-reader-pilot.json before any panel generations.
Rules, original reports, decisive edits, reader packets and world-correct decisions are preserved.
Irrelevant template facts were expanded before generation to similar word lengths; token lengths must be measured with the selected tokenizer.
Canonical decisive assertions repeat source information to make edit support structurally checkable; semantic validity still requires human review.
These four development cases are not held-out research material or independent population evidence.
